definition: to stand between two things as a barrier
description: Inside a dim aquarium with concrete walls. A huge curved glass tank of blue water rises on the left, and a large sea turtle swims slowly past, right up close to the glass, moving its flippers. A young woman in a blue jumper and white trousers presses her hand flat against the thick glass wall, and a young man in a rust T-shirt stands beside her with his hand on the glass too, both smiling and laughing. The glass stands between them and the turtle, and a metal rail runs along the tank.

taps.phrase: to wear a cropped blue jumper
